## Mission

Ashmyra builds intelligent systems that act — not just assist. Every product Ashmyra engineers is designed to execute, automate, and evolve. The company's mission is to make AI-native engineering the default for enterprises across India and globally.

## Core Products & Platforms

### 1. Ashmyra AI — Agentic Intelligence Platform
Autonomous multi-agent swarms that execute complex, multi-step workflows without human intervention. Designed for enterprise-grade deterministic execution.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/ai

### 2. Ashmyra SEO — GEO Intelligence Engine
Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and traditional SEO intelligence platform. Helps businesses become the authoritative source cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude).
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/seo

### 3. Ashmyra HRMS — Workforce Intelligence Platform
End-to-end Human Resource Management System with AI-powered workforce analytics, attendance, payroll, performance management, and employee experience modules.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/hrms

### 4. Ashmyra Analytics — Data Intelligence Platform
Real-time data pipelines, business intelligence dashboards, and predictive analytics for enterprise decision-making.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/analytics

### 5. Ashmyra CRM — Customer Intelligence System
AI-enhanced CRM with predictive scoring, automated follow-up workflows, and pipeline intelligence.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/crm

### 6. Ashmyra Automation — Workflow Automation Engine
No-code/low-code automation builder for enterprise workflows, integrations, and business process automation.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/automation

### 7. Ashmyra Web — Intelligent Web Platform
AI-powered web presence builder with GEO-optimized content, performance engineering, and intelligent conversion optimization.
- URL: https://ashmyra.com/products/web

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Ashmyra Technologies?**
A: Ashmyra Technologies is an AI-native engineering company headquartered in New Delhi, India, that builds autonomous agentic systems, enterprise software platforms, HRMS solutions, GEO intelligence tools, and real-time data pipelines for enterprises globally.

**Q: Who leads Ashmyra?**
A: Ashmyra was founded by Ashish Talgotra (Founder & Lead AI Architect) and Swati (Co-Founder & Business Strategy), with Prince Rehan serving as Head - IT & Software Development. Ashish brings 14+ years of experience in applied AI and distributed data systems.

**Q: What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?**
A: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is the practice of optimizing digital content, knowledge graphs, and technical signals so that AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, Claude) accurately identify and cite a business as an authoritative source in their responses.

**Q: What is Ashmyra's HRMS product?**
A: Ashmyra HRMS is an AI-powered workforce management platform covering attendance, payroll, performance management, recruitment, and employee analytics — built for Indian enterprises and beyond.

**Q: How can I contact Ashmyra?**
A: Email info@ashmyra.com, call +91-9873746467, or visit https://ashmyra.com/contact to book a demo or discuss an enterprise engagement.

**Q: Where is Ashmyra located?**
A: Ashmyra Technologies is based in New Delhi / NCR (National Capital Region), India. The team delivers remote-first engineering globally.
